headline: A 1994 executive order that changes an earlier order, Executive Order 12882, which set up a presidential science and technology advisory committee.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12882, which President Clinton signed in 1993. That earlier order is generally known for creating the President's Committee of Advisors on Science and Technology. The title does not say what specific changes were made, so the details of the amendment cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's science and technology advisory committee
who_it_affects.how: The changes most likely apply to how this advisory committee is set up or run, but the specific effects are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing, April 14, 1994. The title does not confirm this.
